family: integers + positivity: restricted-level Legendre certificates, Riesz order x level
task: Combination: Legendre substitution over the integers (sum_{k<=x} mu(k) floor(j/k) = 1; LP value psi(x)) x one-sided Landau rule (a one-sided excess O(X^alpha) of S(X) = sum Lambda(n) n^(-1/2) - 2 sqrt X gives no zeros in Re s > 1/2 + alpha; alpha < 3/8 passes 7/8) x Riesz smoothing of order k (prime tents: target O(N^(k+1/2)) with any constant, no log factor). Do not take limits of optimal duals (closed). First lemma: for certificates supported on k <= D = X^theta the k-fold integrated sawtooth error is <= C_k D^(k+1), so the certificate is unconditional with error below X^(k+1/2) for theta <= (2k+1)/(2k+2); write the LP whose value G_k(X, theta) is the certified one-sided excess. Controls: E_a weights n^a + n^-a (must return 1/2 + a), Beurling integers (no sawtooth), Liouville-twisted Lambda, Davenport-Heilbronn coefficients: name the failing constraint for each. Rules: tmp/research-2026-11-16/push/BRIEF.md; write only under tmp/research-2026-11-16/push/e2-legendre-riesz-level-phase/ (RESULT.md); local runs through scripts/memcap.sh 8; label steps PROVED / CLASSICAL / MEASURED / OPEN.
